tasks.subject: Implement Time Blocking Using Holiday API (Swagger) on Calendar of the business app
tasks.description:
Integrate time blocking functionality into the calendar module by leveraging the Holiday API (Swagger). This allows staff schedules to be blocked for specific periods, ensuring bookings respect holidays and unavailable times.

Scope of Change

Staff Selection:

Add option to select staff member(s) for time blocking.

Date/Time Selection:

Allow users to specify start and end date/time for blocked periods.

Validate against company working hours and holiday rules.

Calendar Integration:

Enable creation of time blocks directly from the calendar view.

Display blocked periods visually (e.g., shaded or disabled slots).

Holiday API (Swagger):

Fetch holiday data and integrate with time blocking logic.

Ensure blocked times respect holidays and staff availability.

Cross-platform consistency: Apply changes to both web and mobile versions.

tasks.subject: Enable Direct Booking Creation from Calendar with Popup
tasks.description: Enhance the calendar module by allowing users to add bookings directly from the calendar. When hovering over a time slot, an “Add Booking” sign should appear. Selecting it opens a popup with pre-filled booking details (time, date, staff), which users can edit before confirming.

tasks.subject: Fix and investigate Address Selection Alignment with Google Maps & Remove Duplicate Select Address Button

Investigate and resolve issues with address selection alignment in the Business App where results differ from Google Maps native search. Additionally, remove the duplicate “Select Address” button from the bottom of the page so only the top button remains functional, automatically filling out the rest of the address fields.

Scope of Change

Google Maps Integration:

Audit current API usage (Autocomplete, Places, Geocoding).

Investigate why selected addresses are not aligned with Google Maps results.

Ensure selected addresses match Google Maps native search behavior.

UI Fixes:

Remove the bottom “Select Address” button.

Ensure only the top “Select Address” button is visible and functional.

Form Behavior:

When the top button is used, automatically populate all relevant address fields (street, city, postal code, coordinates).

tasks.subject: Implement Permission-Based Editing for Journal Entries with Pending State & Deletion Option

Enhance the Journal module by requiring business owners to request permission before editing journal entries. Until the business owner accepts the request, the entry should remain in a pending state, showing both the new version and the old version side by side. Business owners must also have the ability to delete pending requests.

Scope of Change

Permission Flow:

Business owners must request permission before editing journal entries.

Pending requests are visible until approved or deleted.

Pending State:

Show both old and new versions side by side while awaiting approval.

Clearly mark the entry as “Pending Approval.”
